description: Does this date fall on the claimed weekday? (batch, year boundaries and leap days) — Checks up to 200 claims 'Monday 2026-12-28' against the proleptic Gregorian calendar and reports the real weekday, whether the date exists (2026-02-29 does not), and the nearest date carrying the claimed weekday; a claim 'Friday, 13 March' without a year returns the years in a range where it holds. Built for an agent verifying dates in a document, email or itinerary. Gregorian only (no Julian date

monthDay.description: MM-DD when the year is unknown; needs fromYear and toYear.

name: date-claim-check
